name: Advent Calendar
description: A Views style that renders View results as an advent calendar of clickable doors using a Single Directory Component.
project_description: Advent Calendar adds a Views style plugin (id advent_calendar_advent_calendar) that formats View rows as an advent calendar, rendering each row as a door via the advent_calendar:door Single Directory Component. Doors start closed and open when the visitor clicks them; open state is remembered per door in localStorage. Doors whose backing content is published render as clickable; unpublished ones render as a plain closed door. The style adds options for a wrapper CSS class and optional closed/open door image paths. The bundled advent_calendar_quickstart submodule scaffolds a complete calendar (content type, Year vocabulary, a term for the current year, one door node per day, and a ready-made View). Requires the core Single Directory Components feature, hence a minimum of Drupal 10.1.
